raw_text: Real footage of Indian Army special forces operation! Cross-border strike against terrorist camps! Our jawans are the bravest in the world! This is what happens when you mess with India! The operation was carried out last night. Government will not confirm for security reasons. Jai Hind!
clean_text: Telegram channel shares Bollywood film clip as real special forces operation. Claims cross-border strike against terrorists. No official confirmation because footage is fictional.
